independence_declaration.statement:
I am code-security-reviewer, session 151e8ff3 (task T-DG7-REV-CS-R3). I verified the assignment's sha256, 1b0501e9…9fc. I authored no implementation in the DG7 scope.

Who authored what:
- P7 is by solution-architect, backend-workflow-engineer, kpi-benefits-engineer, frontend-ux-engineer, transformation-analyst and devops-engineer (docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/).
- The acceptance suites are by qa-verifier.
- The drills, host runs, freeze and regenerated handover texts are by the delivery-orchestrator.
- The round-2 repairs I verify are AN-P7F, BE-R7, DO-D8 and DO-D8B, plus the orchestrator's regeneration.

F-DG7-935 is my own round-2 finding. I verify its fix here and did not author the fix. I authored none of the six fixes.

My only writes are:
- evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/code-security/round-3/;
- my three round-3 review files, written with the Write tool.
Every build, test, probe and mutant ran in a disposable --shared sparse clone under $TMPDIR with disposable PostgreSQL clusters. The clone was removed at the end (90-cleanup.log). Validators and register checks ran read-only on the live repository.

I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-3 record. During my run, HEAD moved to 30c29f6c0, the domain reviewer's auto-committed round-3 files. I saw only their names in git status (90-cleanup.log) and did not open them. The candidate at that HEAD is still 60dd90b6. I read earlier-round records (round 2) only for the finding texts.

The assignment says 'round: 7'. The validator (tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs collectVerifications: rec.round must equal the round directory) requires 3 for round-3/, so I record round 3. This contradiction in the assignment is reported here, as in round 2.

checks_run.procedure: Recompute the candidate on the working tree, at HEAD and at the source commit, and diff it against the frozen manifest. Confirm that HEAD is a freeze commit touching only META-excluded files.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git diff --stat 8323dacae HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 [--ref HEAD | --ref 8323dacae… | --diff docs/delivery/candidates/DG7/60dd90b6c5a7af3b.manifest.json]
checks_run.expected: The candidate ID is sha256:60dd90b6…80e9 over 3154 files. HEAD equals the source, or is a freeze commit that touches only META-excluded files.
checks_run.actual:
HEAD is 9c69cd117, 'DG7: freeze round 3', the direct child of the source 8323dacae. It changes only the 3 round-3 assignments, the manifest and stages.json, all META_EXCLUDES; requirements.csv and decisions.md are untouched (diff is 0 lines).
The working tree, --ref HEAD and --ref 8323dacae each give sha256:60dd90b6c5a7af3b502f02be68e6b601fd11e90fcbc0a48166cbc389453a80e9 over 3154 files, exit 0. --diff reports matches: true, with nothing added, removed or changed. The clone at 8323dacae gives the same ID (02-install.log).
This is the DG5, DG6 and DG7-round-2 precedent, so I continued rather than returning BLOCKED.
At the end of my run HEAD was 30c29f6c0 (the domain reviewer's auto-commit), and the candidate there is still 60dd90b6 (90-cleanup.log). There are no errors in these logs.

checks_run.procedure: Disposable --shared sparse clone at the source commit, offline pnpm install from a scratch copy of the store, pnpm -r build, then re-link.
checks_run.environment: $TMPDIR/rv (removed at the end); Node 24.21.0; pnpm 10.33.0; offline
checks_run.expected: Clone at 8323dacae with the candidate ID over the full commit tree; install and build exit 0.
checks_run.actual:
Clone at 8323dacae; candidate --ref HEAD gives sha256:60dd90b6…80e9, 3154 files. Install exit 0, build exit 0. The API build wrote dist/release/register-snapshot.json (412 rows, sha256 cfa6d37876c6, the same as requirements.csv).
The log has two 'WARN Failed to create bin … mth-db … ENOENT' lines from the first install. They occur because packages/db/dist did not exist before the build; the re-link after the build created both bins, which ls shows.
After the build, free scratch was 2.5 GB on the shared host. That limited what I could run (see the F-DG7-963 verification).

checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6|DG5|DG4|DG3|DG2|DG1; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG7; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG7
checks_run.expected: Each historical gate PASS; register rules at DG7 PASS; --stage DG7 fails only because the gate record does not exist yet.
checks_run.actual:
DG6, DG5, DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 (historical): each PASS, exit 0.
--register DG7: 'PASS register rules at DG7', exit 0 (round 2: 18 problems, exit 1).
--stage DG7: 'FAIL gate DG7 (current) (1 problem) – gate DG7: file not found (docs/delivery/gates/DG7.json)', exit 1. This is expected before the round's reviews and the audit exist; it is not a candidate defect. I record that exit 1 here as explained.

checks_run.procedure: Typecheck of the package holding the changed .ts file, lint, prettier on the changed files, bash -n on the drill scripts, shellcheck if installed, and openapi lint. Lint was re-run after an artefact of my own probe was explained.
checks_run.command: pnpm --filter @mth/db typecheck; pnpm lint; npx prettier --check <changed .ts/.mjs>; bash -n deploy/scripts/drill/cleanup.sh deploy/scripts/transfer-drill.sh; pnpm openapi:lint
checks_run.actual:
@mth/db typecheck exit 0. bash -n exit 0. openapi:lint 'PASS docs/api/openapi.yaml: OpenAPI 3.1.1, 965 operations', exit 0.
First lint (10-static.log): 3 errors 'Unexpected any', exit 1. The cause was my own probe file probe-order.config.ts (the given-order sequencer, 'any' at lines 6, 8 and 9). It sat in the clone root while f962.sh ran, and lint ran at the same time. It is not a candidate file.
The re-run with the probe removed and a clean git status gives 'eslint . --max-warnings=0', exit 0 (10b-static-rerun.log).
First prettier run: exit 2, 'No parser could be inferred' for the two .sh files. That was my error in passing shell files to prettier. The re-run on the two changed .ts/.mjs files: 'All matched files use Prettier code style!', exit 0.
shellcheck is not installed: not run, and not claimed. The orchestrator's full typecheck on this candidate was exit 0 (prefreeze-r3/checks.log); I did not re-run the full workspace typecheck because product sources are unchanged since round 2.

checks_run.actual:

checks_run.procedure: F-DG7-960: run the protocol audit for DG7 on the candidate; compare its C3 hits with known-limitations, the release notes and the REQ-DLV-012 register notes; run known-limitations --check and check-handover (default and strict) with protocol-audit-r3.json; read the round-2 repair handbacks' headings.
checks_run.command: node tools/release/protocol-audit.mjs --stage DG7 --root /home/user/My-owns --json $TMPDIR/pa-dg7.json; node tools/release/known-limitations.mjs --protocol-audit …/protocol-audit-r3.json --check; [MTH_STRICT_HANDOVER=1] node tools/release/check-handover.mjs --protocol-audit …/protocol-audit-r3.json
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone at 8323dacae (tools), root = the live repository at HEAD 9c69cd11 (read-only); Node 24.21.0
checks_run.expected: Every C3 hit of the frozen candidate is disclosed with the same count in known-limitations, the release notes and the REQ-DLV-012 notes and marker.
checks_run.actual:
protocol-audit, exit 1 by design (hits present): C1, C4, C6, C7 and C9 PASS; C2 27; C3 7; C5 1. protocol-audit-r3.json also has DG7 C3 = 7, with the same 7 handbacks.
The seventh is T-DG7-DO-D8-devops-engineer.md, missing merge_instructions. I confirmed it by reading the headings and grepping the text. It was committed at 6c606e5b3 (19:15Z), before the AN-P7F register pass (20:58Z).
known-limitations l.62 says 7 (correct), and --check gives PASS, exit 0. check-handover gives PASS, exit 0, in both modes.
But REQ-DLV-012's notes say 'six … The sixth, T-DG7-FE-C3', its completes-after-gate marker says '(six, F-DG7-960 included)', and release-notes.md l.35 repeats 'six'. The disclosure is inconsistent, and the DO-D8 handback is named nowhere.
The AN-P7F, BE-R7 and DO-D8B handbacks have a merge-instructions section or text (the tool's reading agrees).
F-DG7-960 stays OPEN (Low): verification FAIL in the sidecar. I raise no new id for it.

checks_run.procedure: F-DG7-935: the register rule at DG7, and a per-row extract of the 18 D-274 rows (status, evidence, marker, disclosure wording, listing in the release notes). Judge the Q19 extension literally.
checks_run.environment: Live repository, read-only (requirements.csv is a candidate file, unchanged by the freeze commit)
checks_run.expected: The register rule passes on the frozen register. Each of the 18 rows is IMPLEMENTED with evidence and a completes-after-gate marker naming the remaining clause. Real deviations are disclosed as not met.
checks_run.actual:
The register is 412/412 IMPLEMENTED, and the 54 DG7-final rows are all IMPLEMENTED. 23 rows have markers: the 18 rows plus DLV-010, 021, 041, S20-023 and S20-028 (the original D-243 Q19 rows). All 18 have evidence, cite D-274, and are listed in the release notes. --register DG7 gives PASS, exit 0.
Judgement, in two groups:
- Remaining clause structurally after the gate (DLV-005, 014, 018, 028, 031, 039, 040, S20-031, S21-002, S21-004): the clause needs the DG7 round, audit, gate record, seal or pipeline run itself. These are acceptable under Q19.
- Real disclosed deviations (DLV-008, 011, 012, 024, 030; S02-005, S19-015 and S21-003 depend on the regenerated texts): NOT literally met. They are disclosed as 'not met', under the user's D-249/D-270, for the release-auditor.
I accept the mechanism as honest. The one inaccuracy (DLV-012 'six' vs 7) is tracked under F-DG7-960. F-DG7-935 is verified closed.

checks_run.procedure: Direct source review of the P7 security surfaces. Product sources are unchanged since round 2: only the drill scripts and the guard test changed. The surfaces are the OIDC loopback exception (D-258), the config-bundle commit path, the migration-import trigger handling (audit_event append-only), the export/import authorization, and the secret allow-list binding.
checks_run.command: git diff --name-only f22c97b59 8323dacae -- apps packages tools deploy tests …; grep/node probes → 25-code-inspection.log
checks_run.expected: No injection, authorization, integrity or secret-handling defect.
checks_run.actual:
Changed product/tool files since round 2 are only cleanup.sh, transfer-drill.sh, transfer-drill.test.mjs and p7-transfer-guards.test.ts.
OIDC loopback: the exact hostname set {localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]} after WHATWG parsing. '127.0.0.1.evil.example', 'localhost.evil', 'user@evil' and 'localhost.' are refused; 0x7f.0.0.1 and 127.1 normalise to 127.0.0.1 (still loopback). It applies only when NODE_ENV=production and https is not used.
Config-bundle commit: freshRightAt inside the transaction, lockedImport with the If-Match version, plan re-check (planChanged), a version-guarded update, and the audit event config_bundle_import.committed.
Migration import: LOCK audit_event, empty-target check, DISABLE TRIGGER USER on non-audit tables only, with audit triggers asserted enabled before and after; triggers are re-enabled before commit.
Export/import: the organization-scope authorize is present (coverage gap: F-DG7-940).
Allow-list: 46 entries, each bound to a 64-hex valueSha256; the 17 wildcard-path entries are limited to the history/envelope scopes.
No defect beyond F-DG7-940.
